title: New York Cheesecake
summary: Decadent, SUPER DUPER RICH, but seems to be a crowd favourite...
extendedSummary: Decadent, SUPER DUPER RICH, but seems to be a crowd favourite. I have made this for family Christmas' a few time, and seem to fuck it up every single time. The first time, I burnt the shit out of it, and the second Christmas (I don't know who let me do this AGAIN), the inside was not set properly, and it was extremely liquid. Despite my lack of care, the recipe never fails to be yummy, and when I am not making it for others, it always turns out excellent.
source: NYT recipes HEAVILY adapted by me cause im lazy

items: 2 packets of gf scotch finger biscuits

method: Blend/bash biscuits until they are a fine dust, and combined with melted butter
Press the biscuit mixture into the bottom of a cheesecake tin, and set aside in the fridge (Stopped pressing the biscuit mixture up onto the sides cause it ends up being shit and aint worth it)
In a large bowl with an electric mixture, beat cream cheese for a few minutes on high until light and fluffy
In a separate bowl, combine sugar, flour, salt, and gradually add this into the cheese mixture.
Beat in eggs and egg yolks, one at a time, and the cream. Beat well.
Pour mixture into prepared pan and bake for 8 to 10 mins, then reduce oven to 95°C, and bake for 1 hour longer or until set.
Let it cool on a rack, and then transfer into the fridge to chill for at least 3 hours
